With the large influx of ex-redditors, I'm worried that the Voat community as we know it will devolve into how reddit is today. I think requiring minimum CCP is a very good thing and encourages users to contribute quality discussions, but eventually this just might not be enough to keep things the way they are right now.

MetaFilter has been very successful at keeping a serious content-driven community for many years. A $5 membership fee is required for users to submit content and post comments. This ensures that only users who care about the content of the site are the ones contributing while trolls and other people looking to make easy and cheap posts go elsewhere.

Of course I don't suggest that Voat exclude regular users, but maybe we could have VIP subverses that require a membership in order to participate in discussion and submit content while still being able to browse and vote as they'd like. I believe reddit had a Gold Member only hangout that worked similarly to this, but I never bothered to buy Gold.

Let me know what you guys think of the idea. I think it would be a great way to preserve the community as it is now.

Keep up the Nice Voats!
